Roffman Miller Associates Inc decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roffman Miller Associates Inc sold 3,919 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 388,699 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $33.25 million, down from 392,618 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roffman Miller Associates Inc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $738.33B market cap company. The stock increased 0.98% or $0.936 during the last trading session, reaching $96.096. About 3.26M shares traded.
